summary: First-finish smoke test for AI Referee. Backend: all 6 required API checks passed (root, POST /queries valid, POST /queries empty-prompt 400, GET /queries with limit, GET /queries/{id} valid, GET /queries/{id} bogus 404). Frontend: Home renders all data-testids (textarea, sliders, audience/format pills, Compare button). Empty prompt click correctly does NOT navigate. Typing a prompt + Compare navigates to /results. Results shows model cards B/C/D, all 4 response bodies, consensus/trust scores, agreement/disagreement lists, super-answer-card and super-answer-body, and See Full Debate button. Debate page shows thread, 4 legend chips, verdict block, and View Super Answer returns to /results. Mobile (375x812) home has 0 overflow.
passed: POST /api/queries returns 200 with id and echoes payload
GET /api/queries?limit=5 returns list including newly created record (most recent first)
Home renders all data-testids: ask-textarea, slider-goal, slider-detail, audience-{beginner|professional|expert}, format-{paragraph|bullets|table|steps}, compare-ais-button
Empty prompt + Compare AIs does NOT navigate (stays on /)
Non-empty prompt + Compare AIs navigates to /results
Audience/Format pills toggle active styling (bg-white vs bg-cyan/10)
Results page renders model cards B/C/D, all 4 response bodies, score-consensus, score-trust, agreement-list, disagreement-list, super-answer-card, super-answer-body, see-full-debate-button
Debate page renders debate-thread, legend-model-a/b/c/d chips, debate-verdict
View Super Answer button on /debate returns user to /results

failed.issue: data-testid="card-model-a" reported not visible by Playwright is_visible check, though the nested response-model-a body inside it is visible. Likely a framer-motion opacity/transform initial state or wrapper with visibility:hidden animation baseline. Non-blocking as content displays.
failed.evidence: results:card-model-a => False while results:response-model-a => True; other cards B/C/D visible

failed.issue: Slider hint labels 'Leaning Accuracy', 'Leaning Creativity', 'Quick take', 'Deep dive' not observed in DOM text after keyboard ArrowRight on slider-goal — only 'Balanced' seen. May be that the Radix slider does not respond to keyboard focus in headless run, so the value never left midpoint. Not confirmed as an app bug.
failed.evidence: contains 'Leaning Creativity': False; 'Balanced': True. Sliders themselves rendered and interactive by mouse.

action_items: Optional: verify data-testid="card-model-a" wrapper has no persistent visibility:hidden / opacity:0 after framer-motion animation completes (or ensure initial state is at least 0.01 opacity so Playwright's visibility heuristic passes). Content still displays for real users.
Optional: consider using pointer/mouse drag in tests rather than keyboard for Radix sliders; not an app fix.
